subject.title: [MiniMax] M3 native video input support with timestamp-scaling metadata hint (reference branch only)

question: Should MiniMax M3 video support be implemented through the existing provider-owned media-understanding describeVideo seam first, or should OpenClaw add a broader native video content/readVideo contract for agent sessions and tool results?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix shape sets provider API, session/tool-result content contracts, raw-media egress policy, prompt semantics, and generic video direction that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Start with provider-owned MiniMax video
options.body: Add MiniMax describeVideo support behind existing media-understanding policy and keep generic direct chat/readVideo content work in the broader video tracker.

options.title: Define a generic native video contract
options.body: Approve a cross-provider VideoContent/readVideo/session contract first, then port the MiniMax reference pieces onto that core seam.

options.title: Defer MiniMax-specific support
options.body: Leave MiniMax M3 video as reference evidence until generic direct-video upload and raw-media security policy are settled elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Start with provider-owned MiniMax video
recommendation.body: Add MiniMax describeVideo support behind existing media-understanding policy and keep generic direct chat/readVideo content work in the broader video tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is MiniMax model support plus provider/media-understanding boundary work, and the remaining decision is cross-cutting product/API direction.
